name: Kamakiri Ritual
source:
Santi is a mantis. Year after year he managed to stay locked in his own house when "the time comes." But this year is different; his employer's daughter is here. And Santi has no choice but to attend her... in some way.

[Edited from [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2016/games/kamakiri-ritual]Global Game Jam[/url]]
translation:
桑蒂是一只螳螂。年复一年，当“时机成熟”时，他设法把自己锁在自己的房子里。但今年不同了；他雇主的女儿在这里。桑蒂别无选择，只能以某种方式照顾她。

[编辑自[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2016/games/kamakiri-ritual]Global Game Jam[/url]]
